seo.title: Meecrogate — Sovereign, low-code cloud API platform
seo.description: Meecrogate: a lean, sovereign, cloud-agnostic API platform. API gateway, orchestration, identity and process execution described in auditable JSON.

hero.title: Meecrogate
hero.subtitle: The modular cloud-native API platform
hero.description: A composable, modular solution to expose, secure and orchestrate your APIs. Built for the cloud and for traditional environments, and fully configurable without writing code.

fastDeployment.title: Fast deployment
fastDeployment.details: Ship new APIs or features in minutes without waiting on a development team. Everything is configured through the graphical interface, with no code to write.

highAvailability.title: High availability
highAvailability.details: The platform adapts to load on its own. You get high availability without managing infrastructure by hand, even through traffic peaks.

governance.title: Built-in governance
governance.details: Manage security, user access, roles and quotas from one place. Every governance policy is centralised, and auditing is native.

monitoring.title: Native monitoring
monitoring.details: Reach every metric, log and trace in real time. See the health of your APIs at a glance and get ahead of incidents with built-in alerting.

modernArchitectures.title: Modern architectures
modernArchitectures.details: Full support for microservices, serverless and hybrid architectures, so your IT projects move faster while you stay in control of the technology.

noLockIn.title: No vendor lock-in
noLockIn.details: The platform runs on any cloud and can be deployed on premise. Your data and your architecture stay portable, with no dependency on a single provider.

sovereignty.text: Designed and maintained in France. A European solution, GDPR-compliant, that leaves you in full control of your data.

controlStation.title: The central Control Station
controlStation.description: Run, configure and monitor your entire Meecrogate platform from a single graphical interface.

design.title: Design
design.description: Model your APIs and processes in the interface without writing a line of code.
benefits: Visual drag-and-drop interface to design your APIs
JSON modelling of your business processes
OpenAPI documentation generated automatically
Real-time validation of your schema consistency
Ready-made templates to get started faster

configuration.title: Configuration
configuration.description: Set security rules, quotas and orchestrations in a few clicks.
benefits: Centralised security policies (OAuth2, JWT, API keys)
Fine-grained quotas and per-client rate limiting
Data transformations configured without code
Visual orchestration of calls between services
Multiple environments (dev, staging, prod) kept in sync

deployment.title: Deployment
deployment.description: Go to production instantly and benefit from cloud-native scalability.
benefits: One-click deployment to every environment
Multi-cloud support (AWS, Azure, GCP, on-premise)
Smart auto-scaling driven by actual load
Instant rollback when something goes wrong
Blue-green deployments with no service interruption

monitoring.title: Monitoring
monitoring.description: Get a real-time view of how your services perform and behave.
benefits: Customisable real-time dashboards
Smart alerts based on thresholds you configure
Full traceability of every request (distributed tracing)
Performance analysis and anomaly detection
Automated reports for business stakeholders
